description: This PHP class 'MailTransport' extends Symfony's AbstractTransport to provide customizable email transport functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It manages SMTP, secure SMTP, and sendmail configurations, allowing setting of credentials and encryption options, and handles email message sending.

classes.name: MailTransport
classes.description: A PHP class for configuring and sending emails via SMTP, sendmail, or secure SMTP within the OrangeHRM system, extending Symfony's AbstractTransport.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailTransport object with specified scheme, host, and optional port, setting up the appropriate transport method.

methods.name: loadTransport
methods.description: Loads and initializes the mail transport based on current configuration, creating the appropriate transport object.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username credential for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Configures the encryption options, particularly whether to verify peer certificates, based on security type.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Sends the email message using the configured transport.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transport configuration.
